core.notes:
General › Changelog lists this update's window fixes and the Grid Overlay and Dungeon Win rate changes
A window closed near the edge and reopened after the browser got smaller now comes back on-screen
Bring window on-screen on a closed window no longer shrinks it to nothing
General › Changelog catches up: it now lists what changed in 7.0.20 to 7.0.25, which were missing
Dungeon Win rate: Renamed to Dungeon Win rate (was Win rate), by Apoz and Weeble
Dungeon Win rate: After loading older entries for a range, the log scrolls back up to where you were, instead of staying at the bottom
Grid Overlay: Now by Apoz, Weeble and Spiritie
Grid Overlay: New Colours window (Colours menu in the overlay's right-click menu, or the new cog on the Presets list): themes Classic, Classic original (the old Grid Labels script), Colour-blind and Distinct; tones Classic, Vivid, Deep and Intense; Hybrid, Most used or Fixed colours; tile transparency from 0% (no fill) to 60%; a plain edge in your game theme's own border colour or a coloured one, each Full, Semi or Thin; bold and coloured text for names or numbers
Grid Overlay: Presets Default, AWOO+, Calm, Vibrant, Old script look and Alternative (the overlay as it was), plus up to three Custom looks on their own row that you can rename or delete (right-click one). Every change applies at once; a custom preset shows * until you press Save custom preset, and Reset goes back to its saved settings
Grid Overlay: Stats, resources, gold, XP, relics and drop rate keep their own natural colours; recipes get clearly different colours on each grid, and no colour is used twice on one grid
Grid Overlay: The right-click menu is shorter: Uniques and Cleaner tiles are two buttons each, Show/hide stats is on right-click of the grid
Grid Overlay: If you had Mod colours switched off, your grid stays without fill
Grid Overlay: Overlay tiles have crisp edges and are filled right into the corners; colours look the same whatever background the game uses
Grid Overlay: Hovering a tile with the overlay on lights it up clearly (a larger sculpture lights up whole), and the text on the tiles is sharper
Grid Overlay: The lines inside larger unique sculptures are all equally thin and crisp
Grid Overlay: No more short flicker of the tiles when the grid updates
Grid Overlay: A quiet note under the presets list names any unique sculpture missing from the grid (can be switched off in the Control Panel)
Grid Overlay: Cleaner tiles with the overlay off: the 🗿 sculpture heads are hidden (point at the middle of a tile for the game's pop-up), the tiles are less purple, and sculpture outlines are a little thicker
